name: Luv Parade
source:
Welcome to the LUV PARADE! The biggest New Year's rave on planet Earth. Step into the sneakers of a raver who arrived at the event only to discover they've lost track of their ride home. Alone in the crowd with your glowsticks, chapstick, and cell phone, you have to decide which thumpin' techno performance will provide the beats you dance away your last few hours on Earth to. Who knows what you might do or who you might meet? The way the last party of the century unfolds is up to you!

[From [url=https://inkycosmos.itch.io/luvparade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到LUV游行！地球上最盛大的新年狂欢。穿上一位狂欢者的运动鞋，他到达活动现场却发现自己忘记了回家的路。独自一人在人群中，拿着荧光棒、唇膏和手机，你必须决定哪一种震撼的科技表演能够为你在地球上的最后几个小时伴着节奏跳舞。谁知道你会做什么或会遇到谁？本世纪最后一场派对的展开方式取决于你！

[来自[url=https://inkycosmos.itch.io/luvparade]itch.io[/url]]
